content.text: You produce beats. You want to sell them online. But you're in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan — places where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad don't work. Conventional platforms lock you out. This post solves that problem. It explains how to build a sovereign digital commerce stack that accepts crypto payments directly. No middlemen. No 10% fees. Full ownership of your infrastructure. By the end, you'll understand exactly how to deploy a system that sells your beats, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-17|ebooks]], or templates using only tools you control.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This is a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-2|COREMERCH guide to complete]]-deep-dive-cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks|The Complete]] digital commerce infrastructure stack designed for creators in regions where payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. It combines free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store. The core components include hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing — all integrated to work seamlessly. The system is sovereign: once deployed, you own and control every piece. No platform can shut you down. No fees beyond a 0.5% charge for crypto payment processing. This architecture is built to solve the specific problem of financial exclusion, not just work around it.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting — both are free and reliable. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, depending on your needs. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring you retain full data ownership. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, with automated scripts triggering instant downloads after payment. NOWPayments handles crypto transactions, verifying payments on-chain and firing webhooks to deliver products. The system is modular: each component connects via APIs, so you can swap parts as needed. For example, if you outgrow Google Sheets, migrate to Supabase without rebuilding the entire stack.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators selling products like beats, ebooks, templates, or software in regions where conventional payment processors are restricted. If you're in Nigeria, Kenya, Zimbabwe, or Venezuela, this stack gives you the infrastructure to sell globally without relying on platforms that don’t serve your market. It’s also for creators who want to own their entire commerce process — from payment to delivery. By cutting out middlemen like Gumroad (which charges 10% per sale), you retain more revenue. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, switching to NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee saves you $921 monthly.
Own your infrastructure — no platform can shut you down.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, fast, and secure static site hosting. Backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order processing and file delivery logic. Database: Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, ensuring you own your customer records. Storage: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 host your digital products for delivery. Payments: NOWPayments processes over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. For example, NOWPayments’ webhook fires the moment a transaction confirms on-chain, enabling instant product delivery without manual intervention.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack: the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours with GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, or the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for more advanced needs. If you prefer to build yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for instant download. Each stack comes with 30-day support and end-to-end testing. Load your products, configure your payment settings, and launch. The system is designed for creators who want to own their infrastructure — not rent it. Deploy today and start selling without platform restrictions.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Store orders in Google Sheets and deliver files via Google Drive. This architecture gives you full control over your sales process, eliminates platform fees, and works in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the blueprints and templates to build this system yourself.
Retain 99.5% of revenue with NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates, fonts, or software and want to accept USDT or Bitcoin, this same architecture applies. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for every type of digital product. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to download instantly. Whether you’re selling beats in Lagos or ebooks in Caracas, this system ensures you own your infrastructure and keep more of your revenue.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Connect order storage using Google Sheets or Supabase. Upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase to ensure file delivery works. Launch your store and start selling. For full blueprints and templates, download the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you within 48 hours. If you prefer to build yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and Solana. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON — under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to set up a buyer account for crypto payments?
No. NOWPayments does not require buyers to create accounts. They pay directly from their wallet, and the system automatically verifies the transaction on-chain.
What happens if a payment fails?

The system only delivers the product after payment confirms on-chain. If a payment fails, the buyer is prompted to try again. You retain full control over order data and can manually intervene if needed.
Can I scale this system as my sales grow?

Yes. The architecture is modular and scalable. For example, migrate from Google Sheets to Supabase for larger order volumes, or add more products without rebuilding the stack. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook.
Deploy in 48 hours — start selling without platform restrictions.
